The only fully integrated provider of polymer substrate, security features, design, and printing of
paper and polymer banknotes for central banks and state printworks worldwide.

Discover more

innovative security features, to our state-of-the-art analytics tool and first-class support and

## **RRD Ranks #15** in 2026 Ad Age Agency Report, **#9** on MM+M Agency 100 List

For the eighth year in a row, RRD has been named one of the world’s biggest agencies, ranking 15th
in Ad Age’s 2026 Agency Report. In addition, RRD ranked 9th on MM+M’s 2026 Agency 100 list, which
ranks the top 100 healthcare and life sciences agencies in North America.

[READ MORE][149]

## **RRD Earns Top Honors** at North American Paperboard Packaging Competition

RRD was honored with the Package of the Year Award at the Paperboard Packaging Council (PPC) North
American Paperboard Packaging Competition. The winning design — a collaboration with quip on
sustainable product packaging — replaced plastic components with molded pulp to reduce material use
and environmental impact.

[LEARN MORE][150]

[RRD Earns Top Honors at North American Paperboard Packaging Competition]

## RRD Achieves **Highest-Ever Sustainability Scores** from CDP and EcoVadis

In 2025, RRD secured our highest-ever marks from the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP) and a 15-year
high score from EcoVadis. These rankings underscore our ongoing strong commitment to ESG and
sustainability.

certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed

certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone

outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Cybersecurity in Specialized Sectors

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

[icon]

#### Cloud Security and Virtual Environments

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Foundations of Cybersecurity

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

#### Endpoint, Cloud, and Application Security

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

#### Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]

  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]

  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.

  employers recognize and trust.

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

involved told by others, but with their help, it didn’t feel troublesome at all. I’m truly grateful
for their assistance.

##### Suhaib Irfan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

# Creating Confidence in the Connected World^{®}

## At CIS^{®}, we’re harnessing the power of the global IT community to safeguard public and private
## organizations against cyber and cyber-enabled threats. Join us.

[MS-ISAC]

## Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs

Security isn't a solo fight. The MS-ISAC connects SLTTs to a nationwide community defense network
that keeps everyone safer.
[Learn More Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs][64]
Real-time threat intelligence24x7x365 support from the U.S.-based CIS Security Operations
CenterMember-exclusive tools, resources, and collaboration

## World-Renowned Best Practices and Expert Communities

[CIS Hardened Images]
Secure cloud workloads with pre-configured VMs aligned to CIS Benchmarks for compliance and
protection. 
[Learn More CIS Hardened Images®][65]
[CIS Controls]
Protect your organization from cyber-attacks with globally recognized CIS Controls^{®}, companion
guides, and mappings.
[Download & Explore CIS Controls][66]
[CIS Benchmarks]
Safeguard IT systems against cyber threats with more than 100 configuration guidelines across more
than 25 vendor product families.
[Download Latest CIS Benchmarks][67]
[CIS SecureSuite]
Secure your organization with resources and tools designed to harness the power of CIS Benchmarks
and CIS Controls.
[Learn More CIS SecureSuite][68]

## What The Experts Are Saying
* The CIS Controls^{®} take the background and knowledge of cybersecurity experts literally around
  the world and help focus efforts on things that are of most value. Directly impacting the
  adversaries and challenges we face today on our networks.
  Harley Parkes
  Director, ACD (Integrated Adaptive Cyber Defense)
* Without this resource, the hardening of our devices would have taken a lot longer and required
  many meetings between IT and Security to debate which configuration settings to change and the
  impact they could have. The CIS Benchmarks^{™} provided the necessary information to alleviate
  many of the fears IT may have had with changing specific settings.
  Adam
  Banking Information Security Engineer
* We work with sensitive information on a daily basis. The CIS Controls^{®} along with CIS-CAT^{®}
  Pro, a proven and indispensable tool, helps us to evaluate and maintain a security baseline for
  our IT infrastructure.
  Sasawat Malaivongs
  Business Director, ACinfotec

[[CIS Controls Community]][69][[CIS Benchmarks Community]][70]

## Together, We Can Make a Difference

Our CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks communities connect IT security practitioners from around the
globe to help secure our ever-changing world. Our Ambassadors champion the CIS best practices,
making it easier for enterprises everywhere to strengthen their cyber defenses and streamline their
compliance efforts. We hope you’ll add your voice.
[Learn More Together, We Can Make a Difference][71]

## Our Commitment 

CIS operates as a mission driven, nonprofit organization dedicated to making the connected world a
safer place. Our employees adhere to our [Code of Ethics][72], [Leadership Principles][73], and
[Code of Conduct][74], consistent with our collaborative, nonpartisan, vendor-agnostic operating
model. These values guide our decisions and actions and build trust in our capabilities, enabling us
to achieve our mission.

[About Us][75]

# Creating Confidence in the Connected World^{®}

## At CIS^{®}, we’re harnessing the power of the global IT community to safeguard public and private
## organizations against cyber and cyber-enabled threats. Join us.

[MS-ISAC]

## Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs

Security isn't a solo fight. The MS-ISAC connects SLTTs to a nationwide community defense network
that keeps everyone safer.
[Learn More Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs][64]
Real-time threat intelligence24x7x365 support from the U.S.-based CIS Security Operations
CenterMember-exclusive tools, resources, and collaboration

## World-Renowned Best Practices and Expert Communities

[CIS Hardened Images]
Secure cloud workloads with pre-configured VMs aligned to CIS Benchmarks for compliance and
protection. 
[Learn More CIS Hardened Images®][65]
[CIS Controls]
Protect your organization from cyber-attacks with globally recognized CIS Controls^{®}, companion
guides, and mappings.
[Download & Explore CIS Controls][66]
[CIS Benchmarks]
Safeguard IT systems against cyber threats with more than 100 configuration guidelines across more
than 25 vendor product families.
[Download Latest CIS Benchmarks][67]
[CIS SecureSuite]
Secure your organization with resources and tools designed to harness the power of CIS Benchmarks
and CIS Controls.
[Learn More CIS SecureSuite][68]

## What The Experts Are Saying
* The CIS Controls^{®} take the background and knowledge of cybersecurity experts literally around
  the world and help focus efforts on things that are of most value. Directly impacting the
  adversaries and challenges we face today on our networks.
  Harley Parkes
  Director, ACD (Integrated Adaptive Cyber Defense)
* Without this resource, the hardening of our devices would have taken a lot longer and required
  many meetings between IT and Security to debate which configuration settings to change and the
  impact they could have. The CIS Benchmarks^{™} provided the necessary information to alleviate
  many of the fears IT may have had with changing specific settings.
  Adam
  Banking Information Security Engineer
* We work with sensitive information on a daily basis. The CIS Controls^{®} along with CIS-CAT^{®}
  Pro, a proven and indispensable tool, helps us to evaluate and maintain a security baseline for
  our IT infrastructure.
  Sasawat Malaivongs
  Business Director, ACinfotec

[[CIS Controls Community]][69][[CIS Benchmarks Community]][70]

## Together, We Can Make a Difference

Our CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks communities connect IT security practitioners from around the
globe to help secure our ever-changing world. Our Ambassadors champion the CIS best practices,
making it easier for enterprises everywhere to strengthen their cyber defenses and streamline their
compliance efforts. We hope you’ll add your voice.
[Learn More Together, We Can Make a Difference][71]

## Our Commitment 

CIS operates as a mission driven, nonprofit organization dedicated to making the connected world a
safer place. Our employees adhere to our [Code of Ethics][72], [Leadership Principles][73], and
[Code of Conduct][74], consistent with our collaborative, nonpartisan, vendor-agnostic operating
model. These values guide our decisions and actions and build trust in our capabilities, enabling us
to achieve our mission.

[About Us][75]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is identity risk intelligence?

Identity risk intelligence is the practice of continuously monitoring, analyzing, and acting on data
about compromised or exposed digital identities across the surface, deep, and dark web. Unlike basic
breach monitoring, which alerts you after the fact, identity risk intelligence provides the context,
freshness, and provenance of each exposure — enabling security teams to prioritize and respond
before an attacker can exploit stolen credentials, session cookies, or PII.

How is Constella different from dark web monitoring tools?

Standard dark web monitoring tools scan known forums and marketplaces for keyword mentions of your
domain or email addresses. Constella goes further by ingesting, cleaning, and verifying breach data
at scale — 54.6 billion curated records across 125+ countries and 50+ languages. Where other tools
surface alerts, Constella delivers verified identity context: what was exposed, when, from which
source, and how likely it is to be weaponized. That difference determines whether your team chases
noise or acts on signal.

What is an infostealer and why does it matter for enterprise security?

An infostealer is a category of malware designed to silently harvest credentials, session cookies,
autofill data, and browser history from an infected device. Unlike traditional breaches that expose
stored passwords, infostealers capture live session tokens — allowing attackers to bypass
multi-factor authentication entirely. Constella processed 51.7 million infostealer packages in 2025,
a 72% year-over-year increase. Organizations that do not monitor for infostealer-sourced exposure
are effectively blind to one of the fastest-growing attack vectors targeting enterprise identity.

What is the difference between Constella's Build and Investigate paths?

Constella serves two distinct buyer needs. The **Build** path (Identity Data API) is for product
owners, MDR/XDR platforms, fraud teams, and developers who need to embed high-fidelity identity risk
data directly into their own products or detection engines. The **Investigate** path (Hunter+ DRP
platform) is for security teams, CISOs, and OSINT analysts who need a ready-to-use platform for
threat investigation, executive protection, brand monitoring, and digital risk protection. Both
paths draw from the same verified data foundation.

How does Constella's data pedigree methodology work?

Every record in Constella’s database is processed through a multi-stage verification pipeline that
cleans, deduplicates, and enriches raw breach data with source provenance. This means Constella can
tell you not just that a credential was exposed, but where it came from, how recently, and how many
times it has been recycled across subsequent breach compilations. This verified pedigree is what
separates actionable intelligence from raw data volume.

Which industries does Constella serve?

Constella’s identity risk intelligence is deployed across financial services, telecommunications,
retail and e-commerce, public sector, law enforcement, and managed security service providers
(MSSPs). Any organization that manages digital identities at scale — or that needs to attribute
threat actors and investigate identity-based attacks — is a fit for one or both of Constella’s
product paths.

What is account takeover (ATO) and how does Constella prevent it?

Account takeover is a form of identity fraud in which an attacker uses stolen credentials or session
tokens to gain unauthorized access to a user’s account — bypassing passwords and MFA. Constella
detects ATO risk by monitoring for newly exposed credentials and active infostealer logs tied to
your domain, alerting security teams the moment an employee or customer identity appears in criminal
markets. This pre-exploitation signal window is where ATO is stopped.

credentials, financial data, government identifiers, and sensitive personal information worldwide.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is identity risk intelligence?

Identity risk intelligence is the practice of continuously monitoring, analyzing, and acting on data
about compromised or exposed digital identities across the surface, deep, and dark web. Unlike basic
breach monitoring, which alerts you after the fact, identity risk intelligence provides the context,
freshness, and provenance of each exposure — enabling security teams to prioritize and respond
before an attacker can exploit stolen credentials, session cookies, or PII.

How is Constella different from dark web monitoring tools?

Standard dark web monitoring tools scan known forums and marketplaces for keyword mentions of your
domain or email addresses. Constella goes further by ingesting, cleaning, and verifying breach data
at scale — 54.6 billion curated records across 125+ countries and 50+ languages. Where other tools
surface alerts, Constella delivers verified identity context: what was exposed, when, from which
source, and how likely it is to be weaponized. That difference determines whether your team chases
noise or acts on signal.

What is an infostealer and why does it matter for enterprise security?

An infostealer is a category of malware designed to silently harvest credentials, session cookies,
autofill data, and browser history from an infected device. Unlike traditional breaches that expose
stored passwords, infostealers capture live session tokens — allowing attackers to bypass
multi-factor authentication entirely. Constella processed 51.7 million infostealer packages in 2025,
a 72% year-over-year increase. Organizations that do not monitor for infostealer-sourced exposure
are effectively blind to one of the fastest-growing attack vectors targeting enterprise identity.

What is the difference between Constella's Build and Investigate paths?

Constella serves two distinct buyer needs. The **Build** path (Identity Data API) is for product
owners, MDR/XDR platforms, fraud teams, and developers who need to embed high-fidelity identity risk
data directly into their own products or detection engines. The **Investigate** path (Hunter+ DRP
platform) is for security teams, CISOs, and OSINT analysts who need a ready-to-use platform for
threat investigation, executive protection, brand monitoring, and digital risk protection. Both
paths draw from the same verified data foundation.

How does Constella's data pedigree methodology work?

Every record in Constella’s database is processed through a multi-stage verification pipeline that
cleans, deduplicates, and enriches raw breach data with source provenance. This means Constella can
tell you not just that a credential was exposed, but where it came from, how recently, and how many
times it has been recycled across subsequent breach compilations. This verified pedigree is what
separates actionable intelligence from raw data volume.

Which industries does Constella serve?

Constella’s identity risk intelligence is deployed across financial services, telecommunications,
retail and e-commerce, public sector, law enforcement, and managed security service providers
(MSSPs). Any organization that manages digital identities at scale — or that needs to attribute
threat actors and investigate identity-based attacks — is a fit for one or both of Constella’s
product paths.

What is account takeover (ATO) and how does Constella prevent it?

Account takeover is a form of identity fraud in which an attacker uses stolen credentials or session
tokens to gain unauthorized access to a user’s account — bypassing passwords and MFA. Constella
detects ATO risk by monitoring for newly exposed credentials and active infostealer logs tied to
your domain, alerting security teams the moment an employee or customer identity appears in criminal
markets. This pre-exploitation signal window is where ATO is stopped.

signatures being the same or not.

##### Paper Forensics

Our Paper Forensics division provides industry-leading document examination services from
court-qualified expert witnesses. We work closely with individuals, attorneys, and law enforcement
agencies to identify ink and toner anomalies, paper sources, copy and paste signatures or text, and
perform handwriting analysis on any disputed document. You'll receive a concise report of our
scientific methods and findings.

We are paper scientists offering patent-pending technologies to analyze the paper from your

bring a scientific understanding to document forensics others simply can’t.

Patent pending methodology to verify the source of every page within a questioned document. Results

optical properties of every sheet according to international standards. Then, we statistically

source or ream of paper. We can easily identify if any pages within a document were substituted.

* Document type; Will, mortgage, agreement, etc.
* What is the alleged date of the document?
* Is it an original with wet ink signatures or a copy?
* Is it a PDF or photocopy?
* Do you have the document in possession?

**Questioned Signatures**
* Do you think the signatures are forged or altered?
* You should have as many known signatures of an individual as possible for comparison. We recommend
  20-30, but at least 15.
* Get known signature examples from other documents, checks, or known writings.
* Get signature examples from around the same time period as the questioned document, also prior to
  and after the date of the questioned document.
* Documents with wet ink signatures are best.

* We can match the paper from a questioned mortgage note to copies of your mortgage documents, they
  all came from the same paper source and should match.

Much of the fraudulent activity conducted on documents involves altered text and cut & paste
signatures. It is important to hire a forensic document examiner who understands current
technologies that are being used to alter documents. I know and understands these software programs
and how to identify these alterations. Conducting forensic handwriting analysis, document dating and
forensic paper analysis along with thorough understanding of various forgery techniques, then being
able to explain them in scientific terms, is what makes a paper expert necessary.

Our firm has expertise in Paper Science & Engineering, Paper Manufacturing and have spent nearly 30
years working and consulting in the paper industry. We have the expertise in understanding how paper
is made and what unique properties that can be identified in altered documents. There is an untold
story of evidence ready to be uncovered within the paper of altered documents.

In addition, we have experience in Art and Color and its relationship to the optical properties of
paper. Our development of ScanRite Paper ID Technology allows us to determine if any single page
within a questioned document comes from a different manufactured source, allowing us to determine if
it is a substituted sheet. We provide scientific, statistical analysis and reporting to provide
conclusive evidence, not just an opinion.

##### Altered PDFs

One of the most difficult forensics analysis is identifying an altered PDF document. Many document
examiners misdiagnose "cut & paste" text and signatures because they don't understand the lossy
compression that happens when a document is converted to a PDF. 

We understand this technology and can properly identify an altered PDF.

## [Document Protection Services][23]
* Patented, forensic-grade document security
* Lock down contracts, affidavits, and sensitive forms
* Detect unauthorized edits instantly

* Enterprise-level integrity verification

[ Learn About Page-Lock ][24]
[Document Security]

**Documents we protect**
* Wills & Trusts
* Mortgage Documents
* Business Agreements & Contracts
* HR Documents
* Lease Agreements
* Any Important Document

[ Learn more ][25]

##### Page-Lock Technology (click on arrow for details)

Breakthrough encryption technology and military-grade storage to protect your legal documents like
never before. DNA identification codes are discretely embedded into each document, then printed on
our exclusive security paper and stored safely behind multiple layers of encryption. With a unique
"fingerprint" on every page, your information is fraud-proof and verifiable as the original copy.

[Page-Lock]

##### Security Ballot and Document Paper

**DocuDNA Security Papers** protect the authenticity of your documents. We have products available
to protect legal documents, checks, ballots, prescriptions, or any specialized document.

Our DocuDNA Security Papers are embedded with multiple levels of specialized security features, each
identifiable, to protect against document alteration or duplication.

We only work with the best and most secure paper manufactures of specialized security papers. Every
step in the manufacturing, converting, printing and delivery of the paper is monitored, tracked, and
audited for your protection.

When you incorporate our cutting-edge PageLock system into our security paper you have the highest
level of document security available. The security of your document is continuously monitored and is
verifiable.

**DocuDNA ScanRite-Secure Ballot Paper** has been developed to be the most secure ballot paper for
any type of election. We've incorporated the "Science of Document Integrity" into the development of
the most secure and technically advanced security features available in the market. We have
incorporated continuous monitoring and tracking into every aspect of the supply chain to ensure
end-to-end integrity and security.

We've incorporated our patent pending Page-Lock System to ensure every ballot is authentic and can
quickly be verified and authenticated if ever questioned. We can quickly verify the authenticity of
ballots at a rate of up two million per hour.

##### Why protect your important documents?
* According to Biometricupdate.com, the most prevalent form of fraudulent activity experienced by
  businesses and organizations is the use of modified physical documents. Document fraud now costs
  Americans over 600 billion dollars annually.
* In 2023 check fraud cost consumers $24 billion.

##### How much will it cost to contest my parents will?

The cost of contesting a will depends on the complexity of the estate, the state where the fraud
occurs, the legal fees involved, but generally, contesting a fraudulent will can cost individuals
thousands of dollars in attorney fees, with estimates ranging from $5,000 to $10,000 or more in
complex cases.

**Key points about the cost of will and trust fraud:**

**Legal Fees:**

This is the primary expense when contesting a fraudulent will and the cost of hiring an attorney can
vary on the lawyer’s experience and the case’s complexity

**Filing Fees:**

Additional costs include court filing fees, which can differ based on the jurisdiction.

**Expert witness cost: **

If necessary, utilizing a forensic document examiner or other expert witnesses to prove fraud can
further increase the cost of litigation.

**Factors impacting the cost:**

**Estate size:**

Larger estates with more assets are likely to involve higher legal fees in a fraud case.

**Fraudulent actions:**

The nature and complexity of the fraud, such as forgery or undue influence, can influence the cost
of the legal battle.

**State laws:**

Different states have varying rules regarding estate litigation, which will also have an impact on
costs.

**Important considerations:**

**Emotional toll:**

Beyond the financial cost, contesting a will can be emotionally draining for family members,
especially when dealing with the loss of a loved one. This is the biggest factor that led us to
develop our DocuDNA Page-Lock document security system.

## Individual and traditional Speciality Papers

# Welcome to DREWSEN Special Papers

### DREWSEN - A reliable and innovative Family-owned business

DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE is a manufacturer of a range of uncoated, wood-free speciality paper. Each
year more than 450 employees produce 170,000 tons of speciality paper using 3 paper machines at the
production and administrative site in Lachendorf, Germany. DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE has been producing
paper since 1538 and as such is one of the longest established paper manufacturers in Germany.

In Great Britain DREWSEN SPEZIALPAPIERE operates under the name of DREWSEN SPECIAL PAPERS Ltd. since
1985.

 

 

## PROSECURA, PROTECH and PROFINO

# DREWSEN Portfolio

### Three product groups for different application areas

For 485 years DREWSEN has been synonymous with development of highly specialised papers. With
innovative capacity, our own R&D department and our interest in the ever-changing demands of papers
today, DREWSEN continually improves its product portfolio.

 

Our Product Groups are:
* **PROSECURA** - Anti-counterfeiting Protection at its best
* **PROTECH** - Technical Paper for Industrial Refining
* **PROFINO** - Paper for a wide Print and Packaging sector


Since 2019 the group **SUSTAINABLE PAPER SOLUTIONS** offers solutions on the topic ‘paper instead of
plastic’

### Why Us

## Why DYOPATH is the Premier Choice for Enterprise IT Solutions

Learn about [our company][155] and what makes us your best tech partner:
* **Combined 29 Years of Experience** – DYOPATH was formed in 2020 when DYOPATH (from 1996) and
  Single Path (from 2003) joined forces. This brings decades of IT know-how to help solve your

* **98% Customer Satisfaction Rating** – Our focus on great service has earned us high marks from
  happy clients and built long-term business bonds. This number shows our strong commitment to
  quality service.
* **Elite 150 MSP Recognition** – We made the CRN MSP 500 Elite 150 list in 2024, naming DYOPATH as
  one of the top managed service providers in North America. This honor shows our team’s hard work
  and skill.
* **Business-First Approach** – We start with your business goals, not just tech. Our solutions aim
  to bring real results that match your strategic plans. This ensures your tech spending creates
  real value.
* **Comprehensive Service Portfolio** – From IT planning to cybersecurity, cloud services, and 24/7

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

**100:1** digital workers for every human (Jensen Huang, NVIDIA)

## **Accelerating Security Operations with Agentic AI**

[AI]

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of
AI agents streamlines the entire TDIR workflow, from enriching threat data to building
evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

[sign post]

****Unmatched Customer Choice and Flexibility****

Maximize your investment in best-of-breed security tools with an open platform. Gain a unified view
of your security operation without getting locked into a proprietary scheme. Control costs with
advanced data pipeline management that allows you to search data in place and leverage low-cost
storage.

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

Measure engagement to improve the effectiveness of your documents. Identify data and metrics that

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a VPN?

A Virtual Private Network (VPN) provides your business with a securely encrypted internet connection
(or “tunnel”) to securely connect devices to business assets over otherwise unsecured networks.
VPNs, like OpenVPN, work by masking your IP address and encrypting your internet traffic. VPN
protection is an important piece of a layered security protocol that’s essential to protecting
company data as well as an employee's personal data. Using a VPN service gives you the ability to
remotely access important network resources and connect your company’s branches and locations
worldwide. A [zero trust VPN][33] offers the tenets of zero trust built on the solid foundation of a
VPN.

What do VPNs do?

VPNs encrypt traffic, protect privacy, and enable secure remote access. A [remote access VPN][34]
connection secures your internet connection when you work off-site (e.g., coffee shop, hotel,
airport, or even a different country), and routes all of your sensitive network traffic through an
encrypted tunnel. Routing the network traffic disguises your IP address when using the internet,
replacing it with the location and an IP address from the VPN server making its location invisible.
A VPN connection also secures against external breaches.

What is a VPN server?

VPNs work by routing traffic through a private server. If you are using a self-managed VPN solution
like [Access Server][35], you can choose a physical server, or your VPN server can be hosted in
cloud environments. [VPN server resources][36] can help you simplify setting up your own private
server. Alternatively, you can choose a managed VPN solution, like [CloudConnexa][37], which
utilizes cloud-based servers managed by OpenVPN. In any case, the VPN will route all traffic through
a server.

What does a business VPN do?

A [business VPN][38] creates a secure connection over the internet between your devices and your
company's network. Essentially, a VPN creates a protected, encrypted tunnel through which your
sensitive data can travel, providing protection from intruders and a virtual connection to your
office network. Unlike a consumer VPN, which targets mainly personal users who are looking to
protect traffic, access the internet anonymously, or possibly access resources from other regions, a
business VPN is intended for remote and secure access to business resources on corporate private
networks with centralized control capabilities.

What VPN should I use for my business?

OpenVPN offers two secure networking solutions for small, medium, and enterprise [businesses like
yours][39].

[Access Server][40] is best for businesses that prefer an on-prem VPN server or flexibility managing
their full infrastructure through a cloud server. Choose [CloudConnexa][41] if you prefer a
cloud-delivered, managed service.

Our [product comparison][42] can help you choose the right solution for your business.

How much does a VPN cost for a small business?

OpenVPN offers solutions that can fit your budget. Whether you are looking for a [VPN for a small
business][43] or an enterprise, OpenVPN has plans starting at $7 per month per concurrent
connection, and offers a free trial to get started. Find out [how much a VPN costs for your business
size and number of connections here][44].

Can I use a VPN for free?

OpenVPN offers up to 5 free seats and a free trial for CloudConnexa, and 2 free connections for
Access Server. This makes it possible to use a [free VPN for small teams][45]. Teams will have full
functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

What VPN should I use for my business?

OpenVPN offers two secure networking solutions for small, medium, and enterprise [businesses like
yours][39].

[Access Server][40] is best for businesses that prefer an on-prem VPN server or flexibility managing
their full infrastructure through a cloud server. Choose [CloudConnexa][41] if you prefer a
cloud-delivered, managed service.

Our [product comparison][42] can help you choose the right solution for your business.

How much does a VPN cost for a small business?

OpenVPN offers solutions that can fit your budget. Whether you are looking for a [VPN for a small
business][43] or an enterprise, OpenVPN has plans starting at $7 per month per concurrent
connection, and offers a free trial to get started. Find out [how much a VPN costs for your business
size and number of connections here][44].

Can I use a VPN for free?

OpenVPN offers up to 5 free seats and a free trial for CloudConnexa, and 2 free connections for
Access Server. This makes it possible to use a [free VPN for small teams][45]. Teams will have full
functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

OpenVPN technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through our [ support
portal][52].

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations
Average app rating[4.5 stars]
[CNET, Independent IndyBest and PCMag Editors' Choice]
Recommended by the experts

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]
Mail

#### No trackers. No distractions. Just your email.

VPN

#### Stay protected online, wherever you go.

VPN

#### Ultra-fast gaming, anywhere in the world.

Calendar

#### Organize your schedule privately.

Previous slide
Next slide

## Store, share, collaborate. Securely.

[Proton Drive]

### Proton Drive

Safeguard your files and photos with end-to-end encrypted [cloud storage][151].

[Get it for free][152][Explore Proton Drive
][153]
[Proton Docs]

### Proton Docs

Edit as a team with [collaborative documents][154], safe from prying eyes.

[Get it for free][155][Explore Proton Docs
][156]
[Proton Sheets]

### Proton Sheets

Protect and organize sensitive data in encrypted [online spreadsheets][157].

[Get it for free][158][Explore Proton Sheets
][159]

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

[Proton Pass]

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Get it for free][161][Explore Proton Pass
][162]
[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

[Get it for free][164][Explore Proton Authenticator
][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

> transparent and offering bug bounties, they stay ahead of security threats.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

## **Sanchar Saathi App – Download and Features**

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the
portal in one mobile application.

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

The app offers a simple dashboard that lets users access CEIR, TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi, and KYM
features in one place. It is expected to come pre-installed on all new smartphones as per DoT’s 2025
guidelines.

**Note**: The Government of India has made it mandatory for all new smartphones to come with the
[**Sanchar Saathi app**][30] pre-installed, ensuring users stay protected from SIM misuse and mobile
fraud.

### **Key Features of the Sanchar Saathi App**
* Check all mobile numbers linked to your identity
* Verify if a mobile device is genuine using its IMEI number
* Block or unblock lost and recovered phones
* Report fraud calls, scam messages, or fake customer-care numbers
* View official and trusted helpline numbers of banks and telecom operators

The app also integrates with a new DoT service called Chakshu, which allows users to report
suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

## **TAFCOP Consumer Portal – Benefits for Users**

The TAFCOP Consumer Portal helps users monitor and secure their telecom accounts. Some key benefits
include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name
* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

## **Sanchar Saathi and Data Privacy Concerns**

While the Sanchar Saathi App strengthens user safety, there are also concerns about data privacy and
protection. As the platform stores IMEI numbers, mobile identities, and telecom data, questions
arise about how securely this information is managed.

**Some experts believe the app should include:**
* Clear guidelines on how long user data is stored
* Stronger encryption to prevent unauthorized access
* Transparent policies about who can view or use stored data
* Strict penalties for misuse of personal information

To maintain user trust, the DoT is expected to release a comprehensive privacy framework that
defines how Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP data will be handled.

## **Impact of Sanchar Saathi Portal on Telecom Security**

The Sanchar Saathi TAFCOP initiative has significantly improved transparency in the telecom sector.
It allows citizens to directly control and verify their digital identity, reducing the risk of SIM
cloning, fake activations, and identity theft.

Telecom operators are also required to update their systems regularly to align with Sanchar Saathi’s
security standards. This results in better tracking of user activity, fewer spam calls, and a more
accountable network.

## **Way Forward**

Going forward, the Sanchar Saathi Portal and App can be made even more effective by:
* Expanding awareness about its features through digital literacy campaigns
* Encouraging telecom companies and phone makers to integrate it deeply into devices
* Ensuring better coordination with law enforcement for stolen phone recovery
* Introducing multilingual support for rural and regional users

With consistent updates, the Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP Sancharsaathi platforms can play a vital role

## Kdo ?

SPM je hlavním a nejstarším papírenským výrobcem ceninových a speciálních druhů papírů a kartonů v
České a Slovenské republice. Společnost byla založena v roce 1997 českými akcionáři a navazuje na
více než padesátiletou tradici výroby ceninových papírů.

[Čtěte více ...][22]

## Co ?

Ceninové papíry obsahují různé způsoby jištění proti padělání. Slouží k ochraně dokumentů a jejich
zajištění proti padělání. V současnosti je v naší společnosti vyráběno více než 1 000 různých druhů
ceninových papírů s odlišnou technickou specifikací.

[Čtěte více ...][23]

## Jak ?

SPM disponuje jedinečným know-how, moderní papírenskou technologií, vlastním vývojem a výzkumem,
spolu se zajištěním výroby kontrolními a bezpečnostními systémy. Významnou hodnotou společnosti je
vysoká odbornost a tvůrčí schopnost našich zaměstnanců.

[Čtěte více ...][24]

## Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita.

Vysoká a garantovaná kvalita naší produkce je oceňovaná nejen na domácím trhu, ale především na
nejvyspělejších trzích států Evropské unie, kam je exportována převážná část naší výroby. Trvale
usilujeme o neustálé zvyšování nejen dosahované kvality naší produkce, ale zejména i o zvyšování
úrovně poskytovaných služeb zákazníkovi. Podíl exportu dosahuje 90 % celkové produkce a zboží je
exportováno do více než 70 zemí světa. Veškeré zboží vyrobené ve společnosti SPM splňuje
nejpřísnější normy EU. Svou vysokou odbornost deklarujeme uznávanými certifikáty jakosti.

[Čtěte více ...][25]

### [Ceninové papíry][26]

Papíry jištěné proti padělání. Jako ochrana proti padělání se aplikují různé ochranné prvky přímo do
struktury papíru při jeho výrobě, např. vodoznak, hologramy a jiné.

### [Grafický karton][27]

Kreativní grafické kartony jsou určeny pro kresbu tuhou, perem, akvarelovými barvami, pro
hlubokotisk či měditisk. Dále jsou často využívány pro firemní prezentace, přání, tisk vizitek a
jiné.
