# Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award

[Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award Image]
Nominations for the 2026 Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award for Security Design Project of the Year are now
open. The award will recognize projects that went live between July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. The
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Memorial Award will be presented to a consulting or engineering company which
designed and specified a qualified and completed security design project. It will recognize
collaboration, design excellence, uniqueness, creativity, and administration factors which
contributed to a highly successful security project.

The presentation will occur at the next CONSULT Technical Security Symposium

All valid applicants will have registration fees waived for the next CONSULT. Award project
finalists and designers will be featured in Security magazine.

We congratulate Bala Consulting Engineers and Matt Ezold for their winning submission for the 2025
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award on 900 & 801 Church in Nashville, TN.

[Security Magazine Article][34]
[Learn More and Apply][35]

[Award Application][36]

# Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award

[Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award Image]
The Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award recognizes innovation emanating from the security
consulting community. That innovation may be a process, service offering, or unique application of
technology or product. This about introducing novel ideas, methods, or devices, and may be
incremental improvement or radical breakthrough. Ultimately, innovation drives progress and change
by addressing needs, solving problems, and creating new opportunities. Security-specific design
companies, low-voltage system design companies, Architectural and Engineering, and MEP firms all
qualify. Companies are invited to apply for this year's award, with innovations introduced July 1,
2025, through June 30, 2026.

We congratulate ADRM for winning the inaugural 2025 Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award for the
DEFENDER Security Management Platform.

[Security Magazine Article][37]
[Learn More and Apply][38]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access) Logo]

### ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access)
###  
### Nedap Identification Systems
### 

The ANPR Lumo is an all-in-one license plate camera, including embedded software, analyzer, Wiegand
Output and IR illuminator. With a range from 6.5 to 33 feet and reads up to 80 mph, the advanced
camera ensures smooth recognition of vehicles while collecting images of all entry or exit events.
An outstanding add on as a new visitor management system or added visuals to your property's access.
[ **Find Out More >>**][39]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal Logo]

### Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal
###  
### Boon Edam Inc.
### 

Boon Edam designed the Circlelock Combi as a convenient retrofit option to address the risk that
exists with any type of swinging door - once a swinging door is opened by an authorized user, any
number of people may also gain access to a secure area, which is known as "tailgating" or
"piggybacking."

Many facilities use fire-rated swing doors to protect data and assets from destruction by fire, but
this type of door cannot prevent tailgating or piggybacking. The Circlelock Combi attaches to an
existing fire-rated door, converting it immediately into a mantrap solution that prevents
piggybacking 24/7 and eliminates the need for manned supervision, all while maintaining the
fire-rated benefits of the swing door. The Combi also saves considerable space compared to
traditionally built mantrap vestibules that use standard walls and two swinging doors.
[ **Find Out More >>**][40]

# Welcome to SecuritySpecifiers!

[Welcome to SecuritySpecifiers! Image]
The security consultant is a vital link between a building or facility’s requirement for security
and the successful installation of a system to meet that requirement. From risk assessment to
security audit to system design to the details of implementation and practice, it is the security
consultant who identifies, then turns requirement into reality. SecuritySpecifiers allows a variety
of constituencies – OEM's, integrators, facility owners and operators, end-users, and architectural
firms – to access an up-to-date listing of companies and individuals skilled in the design and

# Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award

[Elliot A. Boxerbaum Design Award Image]
Nominations for the 2026 Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award for Security Design Project of the Year are now
open. The award will recognize projects that went live between July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. The
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Memorial Award will be presented to a consulting or engineering company which
designed and specified a qualified and completed security design project. It will recognize
collaboration, design excellence, uniqueness, creativity, and administration factors which
contributed to a highly successful security project.

The presentation will occur at the next CONSULT Technical Security Symposium

All valid applicants will have registration fees waived for the next CONSULT. Award project
finalists and designers will be featured in Security magazine.

We congratulate Bala Consulting Engineers and Matt Ezold for their winning submission for the 2025
Elliot A. Boxerbaum Award on 900 & 801 Church in Nashville, TN.

[Security Magazine Article][34]
[Learn More and Apply][35]

[Award Application][36]

# Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award

[Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award Image]
The Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award recognizes innovation emanating from the security
consulting community. That innovation may be a process, service offering, or unique application of
technology or product. This about introducing novel ideas, methods, or devices, and may be
incremental improvement or radical breakthrough. Ultimately, innovation drives progress and change
by addressing needs, solving problems, and creating new opportunities. Security-specific design
companies, low-voltage system design companies, Architectural and Engineering, and MEP firms all
qualify. Companies are invited to apply for this year's award, with innovations introduced July 1,
2025, through June 30, 2026.

We congratulate ADRM for winning the inaugural 2025 Ed Chandler Security Innovation Award for the
DEFENDER Security Management Platform.

[Security Magazine Article][37]
[Learn More and Apply][38]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access) Logo]

### ANPR LUMO - License Plate Reader (Wiegand Output and/or Stand-Alone Access)
###  
### Nedap Identification Systems
### 

The ANPR Lumo is an all-in-one license plate camera, including embedded software, analyzer, Wiegand
Output and IR illuminator. With a range from 6.5 to 33 feet and reads up to 80 mph, the advanced
camera ensures smooth recognition of vehicles while collecting images of all entry or exit events.
An outstanding add on as a new visitor management system or added visuals to your property's access.
[ **Find Out More >>**][39]

# Product of the Day - 7/27/2026

[Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal Logo]

### Circlelock Combi High Security Half Portal
###  
### Boon Edam Inc.
### 

Boon Edam designed the Circlelock Combi as a convenient retrofit option to address the risk that
exists with any type of swinging door - once a swinging door is opened by an authorized user, any
number of people may also gain access to a secure area, which is known as "tailgating" or
"piggybacking."

Many facilities use fire-rated swing doors to protect data and assets from destruction by fire, but
this type of door cannot prevent tailgating or piggybacking. The Circlelock Combi attaches to an
existing fire-rated door, converting it immediately into a mantrap solution that prevents
piggybacking 24/7 and eliminates the need for manned supervision, all while maintaining the
fire-rated benefits of the swing door. The Combi also saves considerable space compared to
traditionally built mantrap vestibules that use standard walls and two swinging doors.
[ **Find Out More >>**][40]

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

## AI changed everything.
## The threat landscape included.

Attackers now use AI to generate code, move at machine speed, and exploit gaps. The old model was
built for a slower era. That era is over.

0202

## The AI era demands a new advantage. SentinelOne delivers it.

One platform powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence. Built to stop emerging threats at machine
speed and give defenders the upper hand.

The AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform

## Built for Defenders.
## Engineered for Advantage.

Endpoint & Identity SecuritySecuring AICloud SecurityAutonomous SOCGlobal Services

Autonomously stop supply chain, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse with AI-native
endpoint and identity protection unified in a single lightweight agent.
* Stop threats at machine speed with behavioral AI
* Detect and disrupt identity-based attacks in real time
* Real-time, AI-automated response and remediation
* Deploy in SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, and air-gapped environments

Detect, contain, and respond to threats in real time with AI-native protection. AI that does more
than protect your business. It protects the AI your business relies on.

### Less Noise. More Impact from Every Analyst

Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine response so analysts can
focus on higher-value decisions.

Intuitive by Design

### Faster Decisions. Simpler Operations.

A unified experience that brings visibility, investigation, and action together in a single console

## Our Heritage

## SPMCIL though a new entity is composed of units that have a rich & long history of handling the
## security printing & minting in the nation.

## 18th Century- Minting of coins started at Calcutta Mint. In 1790 modern machinery was brought
## from England and second Mint was established. Bronze, Silver and Gold coins were getting Minted
## from these mints.

## 1918- British sovereign were minted during 1918 as the Mint in Mumbai was declared as branch of
## Royal Mint of London.

# Real change starts from within

Sustana is an industry-leading producer of quality fiber-based products and services built on a
solid commitment to sustainability and continuous improvement. 

From recovery to fiber to paper production, we produce the clean materials used in coffee cups, food
packaging, your favorite book, and so much more.

Let’s get started. 

[ Take a closer look ][65]

## In the spotlight

Corporate

#### We are Sustana

We are proud to share that all our fiber and paper products and recovery services can now be found
under a united Sustana brand.

As one, we are stronger and amplify our solid commitment to sustainability and continuous
improvement.

Join us on our journey to create real change from within.

[ Discover ][66]
[1 bright printing]
Fiber

#### Sustana EnviroLife™ is a 100% sustainable recycled fiber for use in the production of food
#### grade and luxury packaging

Manufactured in North America and is compliant with FDA standards for use in direct food contact at
100% inclusion without the need of a barrier or coating.

The impact of EnviroLife on climate change is 26 percent lower than the average virgin fiber. It
also requires 9 times less water to produce than virgin fiber.

[ Discover ][67]
Green champions

#### Our green champions

Some of the world’s leading sustainable organizations are using Sustana products to further their
sustainability objectives and reduce their environmental impact.

[ Discover ][68]

### Our
### products

## Paper

## Fiber

## Recovery

[visual carousel paper]
Committed to strict environmental standards

When it comes to paper, we are committed to continuously reducing the environmental impact of our
operations and products. 

[ Discover our paper products ][69]
[visual carousel fiber]
Committed to strict environmental standards

Our premium 100% recycled fibers are the ingredient within everyday products such as coffee cups,
sandwich wraps, food service packaging, printing papers, tissue and more.   

[ Discover our fiber products ][70]
[visual carousel recovery]
Committed to strict environmental standards

North America’s largest high grade paper recycler  

Sustana Recovery is committed to assisting our clients to generate maximum value from their waste
paper management solutions. Whether you seek a one-time clear out, an efficient ongoing recycling
program or a secure shredding service, our expert audit teams will take time and care to tailor a
custom solution that will be right for you. 

[ Discover our recovery services ][71]

### ESG report

## Bringing paper products full circle with sustainable innovation

Sustainable growth starts with investing in our products, our people, and responsible business
practices. See how we’re working to reduce our environmental impact.

[ Download our ESG report ][72]
[homepage creating value]
[Visual about our purpose]

## About us

Sustana is dedicated to finding new ways of putting clean materials within more essential everyday
paper products—sustainably, responsibly, and meaningfully. We are an industry-leading producer of
quality fiber-based products and services, built on a solid commitment to sustainability and
continuous improvement.

From recovery to fiber to paper production, Sustana produces the clean materials used in coffee
cups, food packaging, your favorite book, and so much more. At Sustana, creating real change starts
from within.

[ Discover more about Sustana ][73]

## Our clients

## Tenable Hexa AI

Built on Tenable’s Exposure Data Fabric, [Hexa AI][160] understands how risk moves through your
environment, prioritizes precisely, and enables coordinated action across teams and AI agents to
eliminate exposure before it becomes impact.

## Unified exposure management across every domain.

### [ Cross-Domain Exposure ][162]

Stop treating security as a series of isolated events and start seeing the full attack path. Tenable
One unifies disparate security data to reveal how a minor weakness in one domain can escalate into a
catastrophic breach in another.

[ ][163]

### [ AI Exposure ][164]

Gain full visibility into your AI supply chain, from LLM integrations to the data pipelines powering
them. Proactively identify misconfigurations and shadow AI to ensure your competitive edge doesn't
become a new entry point.

[ ][165]

### [ Cloud Exposure ][166]

Reduce cloud risk by closing misconfigurations, risky entitlements, and vulnerabilities across
multi-cloud and hybrid environments — all in one powerful CNAPP.

[ ][167]

### [ OT Exposure ][168]

Bridge the gap between IT and OT to manage security across your entire cyber-physical ecosystem.
Combine deep visibility with industry-leading exposure intelligence to protect critical
infrastructure without disrupting innovation and operations.

[ ][169]

### [ Identity Exposure ][170]

Uncover weaknesses and overprivileged access in Active Directory and Entra ID. Stop lateral movement
by hardening your identity infrastructure and identifying real-time threats before they can
escalate.

[ ][171]

### [ Vulnerability Management ][172]

Eliminate blind spots by continuously discovering assets across your modern IT environment. Use
risk-based prioritization to focus your team on the vulnerabilities that attackers are most likely
to exploit first.

When something breaks at 2 a.m., the last thing you need is a voicemail box. Every call into
TeckPath is answered immediately, triaged by urgency, and routed to the right on-call engineer, with
a ticket already opened and the details already captured. Critical incidents reach a human fast.
Routine requests are queued with clear SLAs — nothing falls through.

### Always answered

Calls get a live, intelligent response in seconds — 24 hours a day. No voicemail, no waiting until
morning.

### Triaged instantly

Every call is sorted by urgency the moment it comes in, so a security incident never sits in the
same queue as a password reset.

### Escalated correctly

Urgent issues page your on-call engineer right away with full context. You’re talking to the right
person, fast.

# VHP Security Paper specialises in manufacturing security paper for banknotes

A leading player in the banknote industry, VHP Security Paper has been producing and supplying
state-of-the-art banknote paper to Central banks and high security printers throughout the world for
more than 200 years.

In addition to banknote paper, VHP Security Paper also offers a wide range of security features such
as watermarks and security threads.

## Papetiers depuis 400 ans

### Qualité à la française

Au cœur des Alpes, Les Papeteries de Vizille, imprégnées d’un savoir-faire séculaire fabriquent des
produits vendus en France et dans le monde entier.
De taille humaine, agiles et certifiées **ISO 22000 - ISO 9001 et ISO 50001**, Les Papeteries de
Vizille possèdent 2 activités, sur un même site :

- La fabrication de** papiers de spécialité **

- La production de **sacs industriels en papier de moyenne et grande contenance **

Les Papeteries de Vizille s’engagent auprès des générations futures à la transmission des savoirs
tout en assurant un avenir durable, pour une industrie plus verte. 

[Mieux nous connaitre][50]
[bâtiments historique dans le parc des papeteries de Vizille]

## Engagés au quotidien

### Amélioration continue

Les Papeteries de Vizille travaillent à l'amélioration de leurs consommations quotidiennes et de
leur impact environnemental afin de proposer une industrie plus respectueuse de son écosystème :
pâtes certifiées** PEFC ou FSC**, amélioration du **mix énergétique** (turbines hydroélectriques,
chaufferie biomasse), **traitement **physico-chimique et biologique **des eaux**, amélioration des
process pour diminuer la consommation d'eau et d'électricité...

Ce sont autant d'actions et de projets qui nous permettent d'intégrer notre politique
environnementale à notre stratégie d'entreprise. 

[Engagés pour l'environnement][51]
[Papeteries de Vizille au pied des Alpes ]

## Papetiers depuis 400 ans

### Qualité à la française

Au cœur des Alpes, Les Papeteries de Vizille, imprégnées d’un savoir-faire séculaire fabriquent des
produits vendus en France et dans le monde entier.
De taille humaine, agiles et certifiées **ISO 22000 - ISO 9001 et ISO 50001**, Les Papeteries de
Vizille possèdent 2 activités, sur un même site :

- La fabrication de** papiers de spécialité **

- La production de **sacs industriels en papier de moyenne et grande contenance **

Les Papeteries de Vizille s’engagent auprès des générations futures à la transmission des savoirs
tout en assurant un avenir durable, pour une industrie plus verte. 

[Mieux nous connaitre][50]
[bâtiments historique dans le parc des papeteries de Vizille]

## Engagés au quotidien

### Amélioration continue

Les Papeteries de Vizille travaillent à l'amélioration de leurs consommations quotidiennes et de
leur impact environnemental afin de proposer une industrie plus respectueuse de son écosystème :
pâtes certifiées** PEFC ou FSC**, amélioration du **mix énergétique** (turbines hydroélectriques,
chaufferie biomasse), **traitement **physico-chimique et biologique **des eaux**, amélioration des
process pour diminuer la consommation d'eau et d'électricité...

Ce sont autant d'actions et de projets qui nous permettent d'intégrer notre politique
environnementale à notre stratégie d'entreprise.

The cybersecurity platform for the AI Age - built on Zero Trust to protect users, workloads,
branches and devices through the world’s largest inline security cloud.

##### AI Security

Embrace AI with confidence using Zscaler AI Protect, a unified solution to secure AI at scale.

Draw on insights from the world’s largest inline security cloud and third-party sources to assess
risk and detect and contain breaches.

Phishing is getting quieter and more dangerous. Although volume is down ~20% YoY, AI is accelerating
targeted lures and initial access.

 

Zscaler ThreatLabz uncovered how attackers are now moving beyond the inbox; by probing exposed
attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.
